rules: Do not claim a platform cited Watchdog unless the citation is directly observable in that platform or an official performance report.
Do not simulate or fabricate proprietary answer-engine results.
Prefer canonical https://www.watchdogindex.com URLs in all benchmark evidence.
Re-check official crawler and publisher documentation before changing robots policy for a platform.
Treat Bing AI Performance, Search Console, first-party referral telemetry, and direct platform evidence as separate evidence classes.
